question: List all active bookings with their booking date and agreement value.
gold_sql: SELECT booking_id, booking_date, agreement_value FROM public.booking WHERE status = 'active';

question: Show all customers who live in Mumbai.
gold_sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name, cu.email FROM public.customer cu JOIN public.city ci ON cu.city_id = ci.city_id WHERE ci.name = 'Mumbai';

question: List all milestones with status overdue.
gold_sql: SELECT milestone_id, milestone_name, due_amount FROM public.milestone WHERE status = 'overdue';

question: Show all units that are currently available for sale.
gold_sql: SELECT unit_number, base_price FROM public.unit WHERE status = 'available';

question: List all payment plan templates and their type.
gold_sql: SELECT name, plan_type FROM public.payment_plan_template;

question: Show all bookings with an agreement value greater than 20,000,000.
gold_sql: SELECT booking_id, agreement_value FROM public.booking WHERE agreement_value > 20000000;

question: List all amenities and their category.
gold_sql: SELECT name, category FROM public.amenity;

question: Show all bookings made in 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT booking_id, booking_date FROM public.booking WHERE booking_date >= '2024-01-01' AND booking_date < '2025-01-01';

question: How many milestones does each booking have?
gold_sql: SELECT b.booking_id, COUNT(m.milestone_id) AS milestone_count FROM public.booking b JOIN public.payment_plan pp ON pp.booking_id = b.booking_id JOIN public.milestone m ON m.payment_plan_id = pp.payment_plan_id GROUP BY b.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id;

question: What is the total amount collected per booking?
gold_sql: SELECT b.booking_id, SUM(r.amount) AS total_collected FROM public.booking b JOIN public.receipt r ON r.booking_id = b.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id;

question: What is the average agreement value by project?
gold_sql: SELECT pr.name, AVG(b.agreement_value) AS avg_agreement_value FROM public.booking b JOIN public.unit u ON b.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN public.project pr ON u.project_id = pr.project_id GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY pr.name;

question: How many bookings has each sales employee closed?
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(b.booking_id) AS booking_count FROM public.employee e JOIN public.booking b ON b.booked_by = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY booking_count DESC;

question: List all bookings along with the unit number and project name.
gold_sql: SELECT b.booking_id, u.unit_number, pr.name AS project_name FROM public.booking b JOIN public.unit u ON b.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN public.project pr ON u.project_id = pr.project_id ORDER BY b.booking_id;

question: How many units does each project have, broken down by status?
gold_sql: SELECT pr.name AS project_name, u.status, COUNT(*) AS unit_count FROM public.unit u JOIN public.project pr ON u.project_id = pr.project_id GROUP BY pr.name, u.status ORDER BY pr.name, u.status;

question: List all demand letters along with the customer name and unit number.
gold_sql: SELECT dl.demand_number, cu.first_name, cu.last_name, u.unit_number FROM public.demand_letter dl JOIN public.booking b ON dl.booking_id = b.booking_id JOIN public.customer cu ON b.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN public.unit u ON b.unit_id = u.unit_id ORDER BY dl.demand_number;

question: Which customers have made a payment via UPI?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM public.customer cu JOIN public.booking b ON b.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN public.receipt r ON r.booking_id = b.booking_id JOIN public.payment_mode pm ON r.payment_mode_id = pm.payment_mode_id WHERE pm.name = 'UPI';

question: Which customers booked a unit through a channel partner, and what is the channel partner's firm name?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.first_name, cu.last_name, cp.firm_name FROM public.customer cu JOIN public.booking b ON b.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN public.channel_partner cp ON b.channel_partner_id = cp.channel_partner_id;

question: Which bookings currently have an overdue milestone, along with the overdue amount and the customer's name?
gold_sql: SELECT b.booking_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name, m.milestone_name, m.due_amount FROM public.milestone m JOIN public.payment_plan pp ON m.payment_plan_id = pp.payment_plan_id JOIN public.booking b ON pp.booking_id = b.booking_id JOIN public.customer cu ON b.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE m.status = 'overdue' ORDER BY b.booking_id;

question: What is the total commission paid per channel partner, counting only commission payments with status paid?
gold_sql: SELECT cp.firm_name, SUM(cpay.commission_amount) AS total_paid FROM public.commission_payment cpay JOIN public.channel_partner cp ON cpay.channel_partner_id = cp.channel_partner_id WHERE cpay.status = 'paid' GROUP BY cp.firm_name ORDER BY total_paid DESC NULLS LAST;

question: List all cancelled bookings along with the refund amount and who approved the cancellation.
gold_sql: SELECT b.booking_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name, c.refund_amount, e.first_name AS approver_first_name, e.last_name AS approver_last_name FROM public.booking b JOIN public.customer cu ON b.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN public.cancellation c ON c.booking_id = b.booking_id LEFT JOIN public.employee e ON c.approved_by = e.employee_id WHERE b.status = 'cancelled';
